Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@pacdevs.au>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood demo — cross-region availability

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for agreeing to walk Finova through Redwood. We'd like to get a single session with engineering, product and our APAC integrations lead on the call so we can move fast. Proposed slot:

  - Tue, 30 Mar — 10:00 AM ET / 15:00 GMT / 00:00 AEST (next day)

Tom (cc) will join from Sydney — he said the late-night slot is doable on his side this week. Laura in our New York office will also be on.

Attached is a short agenda and a few items we want to cover (high level architecture, latency SLOs, and private deployment options). Can you confirm and send an invite? If that exact time won't work, two alternate windows we could take are: 9:00 AM ET or 2:00 PM ET.

Appreciate it — looking forward.

Best,
Ella Johnson
Director of Product, Finova
ella.j@finova.com
Finova Solutions

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (14 KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ella Johnson <ella.j@finova.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, Tom Lee <tom.lee@pacdevs.au>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — cross-region availability

Hi Ella — thanks for the agenda and proposed times. Quick heads-up: Europe moves to DST on Sun, 29 Mar this year which will shift the GMT->local offsets by one hour for EU/UK attendees; Australia/NZ also have local changes in early April that can flip overnight windows for APAC. That means the 00:00 AEST crossing on Tue->Wed is brittle if we need any follow-ups the next day.

Two ways to make this smoother while keeping the key people in:

  1) Split into two short focused sessions (30–40m): EU/US overlap first (ideal for product+eng), and a separate APAC follow-up that can be recorded and have a short Q&A the next morning.
  2) Move the single session earlier to avoid the midnight APAC window — proposed new slot: Tue, 30 Mar — 8:00 AM ET / 13:00 GMT / 22:00 AEST. That keeps Tom in reasonable hours while preserving overlap.

I can send both calendar invites (option 1: two events, option 2: single revised event) and include a recording link for APAC if we split. I attached a small .ics that shows both options with time-zone conversions so it's easier to eyeball.

Which would you prefer? If you want option 2, I can lock the invite now. If option 1, Laura (cc) will run the EU/US session and I’ll take the APAC Q&A.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
(Attachment: timezone-conversion.ics)
